name: Dauthi Voidwalker
oracle_text:
Shadow (This creature can block or be blocked by only creatures with shadow.)
If a card would be put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, instead exile it with a void counter on it.
{T}, Sacrifice this creature: Choose an exiled card an opponent owns with a void counter on it. You may play it this turn without paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: If a card would be put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, instead exile it with a void counter on it.

needs.what: a counter rider on the replace_graveyard static: the redirected card enters exile with N counters of a named kind on it (here one 'void' counter), so a later selector with has_counters: "void" over zone exile, owner opponent can find exactly the cards this replacement exiled. Only cards, not tokens (affects_token: false), and only cards an opponent owns (affects_player: "opponent")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_graveyard (Leyline of the Void) takes affects_player, affects, destination and affects_token only; engine.zones' graveyard replacement returns just a destination Zone and has no way to put counters on the card as it arrives. and_create is a replace_dies-only rider and creates tokens, not counters. Without the void counter the card's activated ability (expressible as grant_playable with objects {zone: exile, owner: opponent, has_counters: "void"}, playable: "this_turn", playable_free: true) would have nothing to choose, so writing the static without the counter would silently break the second ability
